attchmntText: Embassy Office Parks REIT has informed the Exchange regarding 'Redemption of Commercial Papers Tranche XI'.
voiceSummary: Embassy Office Parks REIT fully redeemed its listed Commercial Papers Tranche XI on November 11, 2026. The redemption was for an aggregate amount of 400 Crore rupees. The ISIN for the instrument is INE041014114. The redemption was based on maturity. A total of 8,000 commercial papers were redeemed. The due date for redemption was November 11, 2026. The actual redemption date was also November 11, 2026. The outstanding amount is now nil. Interest payment details are not applicable for this specific notice as the focus is on redemption. The announcement confirms fulfillment of payment obligations pursuant to SEBI master circulars dated July 11, 2025, and October 15, 2025.
